name: IC Power Switching Regulator — buck, boost, 80V — TSSOP
description: Surface-mount 80V buck and boost switching regulator ICs available in TSSOP package footprints including HTSSOP-28 and HTSSOP-31 variants.
selection_hints: Choose between HTSSOP-28 with 0.65mm pitch and HTSSOP-31 with 0.5mm pitch footprints based on PCB layout requirements.
Prefer Tier A rated parts such as LM5175PWP and LM5176PWP over Tier B parts like LT8705AxFE when higher quality tiering is needed.
Ensure board layouts accommodate exposed pad thermal vias defined by the footprint specifications.
avoid_when: The design requires through-hole components rather than surface-mount TSSOP packages.
Switching regulator topologies other than buck or boost are required.
The application requires footprints other than the specified HTSSOP-28 and HTSSOP-31 land patterns.
